assets.prompt:
Use case: game-art sprite atlas. Create ONE square 4x4 contact sheet of sixteen different original modern paintings for TableMax's Modern Art implementation. This is a precise texture atlas, not a photo of a sheet. Exactly four columns and four rows, sixteen equal square tiles aligned edge-to-edge. Boundaries at exactly 25%, 50%, 75% of canvas width and height. Each separate painting fills its tile all the way to its four edges. NO gutters, no grid lines, no separators, no frames, no border, no outer margin, no drop shadows between tiles, no card chrome. All tiles are frontal flat scanned artwork with subtle real canvas/paper surface and crisp printed tabletop-card quality, warm pigment richness, strong silhouettes readable as tiny card thumbnails. Every tile a fully independent composition that stops precisely at its own tile edges, no objects crossing between tiles. No words, letters, writing, numerals, signatures, captions, labels, logos or watermarks anywhere. The output is original interpretive game artwork, not reproductions or forgeries of known artworks. Square canvas, ideally 1536 by 1536 pixels.
STYLE FAMILY: black, charcoal gray, ivory, pale jade and muted teal abstract human portraits and gestural linework. Painterly contemporary collage, expressive blocky faces, calligraphic brush contours, textured paper and canvas. Restrained palette, a few teal accent fields. Varied close-up profiles, paired faces, masks, eyes, hands and abstract geometry; entirely original imagery, no artist names.
EXACT ROW-BY-ROW TILE PLAN (each description is one square tile):
Row 1: angular ivory profile on charcoal; charcoal frontal face with jade circle; teal abstract eye and sweeping black curve; two gray profiles facing opposite directions.
Row 2: fragmented black mask on ivory; jade oval portrait with scratchy charcoal hair; hand and face collage in gray; single bold black eye above an ivory crescent.
Row 3: pale teal face cut by charcoal bands; gestural black head with small green square; interlocking gray and ivory portrait silhouettes; thin charcoal lines forming face over teal field.
Row 4: dark monochrome bust with ivory cheek; two ivory eyes inside jade abstract mask; charcoal profile with gray concentric curves; asymmetrical ivory face with black vertical paint strokes.
CRITICAL: sixteen fully distinct square art tiles, strictly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, all equally sized, directly touching, NO white seams, no intervening gaps. Full-bleed within every cell and to the outer image edges.
assets.visualVerification: 16 distinct edge-to-edge square paintings; clear 4x4 row-major grid; no text, frames or gutters; recognizable portrait/eye/gesture silhouettes at thumbnail scale; neutral/jade family reads consistently.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic tabletop board-game box cover thumbnail for TableMax's Modern Art implementation. Create an ORIGINAL portrait image, exact 4:5 aspect ratio, ideally 1024x1280 pixels. Warm bright physical wooden table, beautiful actual printed tabletop game materials photographed in gentle daylight from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Three large square painting cards in foreground, loosely overlapping: one black/ivory/teal abstract portrait, one terracotta and ochre geometric pop artwork, one rich turquoise bird among coral flowers. A few stacks of cream, ochre, teal and coral money chips at the bottom right. Behind the cards, a small cream chipboard value board with EXACTLY five vertical colored columns (gray, terracotta, cobalt blue, emerald green, warm gold), and four blank rows per column, modest blank tile markers without numbers. A simple small wooden auction gavel at the side. Real paper stock edges, subtle canvas-print texture on artwork, warm maple wood grain and natural contact shadows. Museum auction tabletop atmosphere, tasteful premium tabletop product photograph, pleasing composition readable at a small 360x450 box cover. Cards are original interpretive artworks, not replicas of named painters. Frame the whole composition to fit 4:5, the art cards occupy the lower and middle image, board unobtrusive behind. NO title, NO text, NO words, NO letters, NO numerals, NO logos, NO signatures, NO watermarks, no product box, no people, no UI, no border. Full-bleed portrait to all outer edges. Real modern-art tabletop card-game components, not a videogame scene.
assets.visualVerification: Warm daylight physical tabletop with three original art cards, wooden auction gavel, stacked chips and five colored value columns. No title, numbers, artist signature or brand logo; realistic paper edges/materials, readable 360x450 thumbnail. Source aspect ratio 1122:1402 rounded to 4:5 with 0.036% ratio difference.
